Players Committee card image of [[Far More Frightening Than Death]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “USED: Stack top card of Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) on opponent's leader (or character of ability > 3) at a battleground. LOST: If your Inquisitor in battle with a Jedi, Padawan, or 'Hatred' card, add one battle destiny (add two if with all three).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Far%20More%20Frightening%20Than%20Death.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Far More Frightening Than Death.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
